<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(fr):
    g=[]; s=[]; pl=None
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        c=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]; r=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
        if n['color']=='N': g.append((min(r),min(c)))
        elif n['color']=='S': s.append((min(r),max(r),min(c),max(c)))
        elif n['color']=='b': pl=(min(r),max(r),min(c),max(c))
    return ('ng',len(g),'g0',sorted(g)[0] if g else None,'pl',pl,'S',sorted(s))
print('BEFORE', snap(current_frame))
r = action(['ACTION7'])
print('AFTER ACTION7', snap(current_frame))
print('reward', r.get('reward'), 'done', r.get('done'), 'board_changed', r.get('board_changed'), 'anim', r.get('animation'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def snap(fr):
    g=[]; s=[]; pl=None
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        c=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]; r=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
        if n['color']=='N': g.append((min(r),min(c)))
        elif n['color']=='S': s.append((min(r),max(r),min(c),max(c)))
        elif n['color']=='b': pl=(min(r),max(r),min(c),max(c))
    return ('ng',len(g),'g0',sorted(g)[0] if g else None,'pl',pl,'S',sorted(s))
print('BEFORE', snap(current_frame))
r = action(['ACTION7'])
print('AFTER ACTION7', snap(current_frame))
print('reward', r.get('reward'), 'done', r.get('done'), 'board_changed', r.get('board_changed'), 'anim', r.get('animation'))
